study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
exposure: Colocation of study visit with initial well-child visit
Provision of an alternate phone number by the participant
cohort: The study included 501 healthy mother-infant dyads participating in a prospective study on newborn jaundice.
finding: Study completion was significantly associated with colocation of the study visit with the initial well-child visit and the participant providing an alternate phone number.
